fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 (near 0x710068a6e8) stores vptr 0x7104f728b8 and stores the object at boma+0x180; the same class is also built by the g0035/g0151 builders (other battle objects).

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Stored with the vptr. Methods reach PostureModule [+0x8]+0x38, StatusModule +0x40, GroundModule +0x58, ModelModule +0x78, VisibilityModule +0x150.

fields.name: shadow_type
fields.evidence: Unexported getter vtable +0x90 (f_71004c2020). Setup (vtable +0x28, f_71004c17b0) stores its int argument. update (vtable +0x58, f_71004c1c90): type 0 draws without recomputing size, types 1 and 2 compute draw_size from the joint at +0x30, type > 2 never draws; type 1 additionally drives on_ground. reset sets on_ground/+0x3E to (type == 1). Initial 2.

fields.name: size
fields.evidence: set_size export -> vtable +0x60 (f_71004c1fc0) stores the float here; setup writes its float argument here and at +0x28. update clamps it between size_min (+0x18) and size_max (+0x1C) and multiplies it by the joint scale to get draw_size. Initial 10.0.

fields.name: size_min
fields.evidence: Unexported setter vtable +0x70 (f_71004c1fe0) stores two floats at +0x18/+0x1C. Lower clamp of size in update (also the minimum in the ground-distance variant). Initial 4.0.

fields.name: size_max
fields.evidence: Second float of setter vtable +0x70; upper clamp of size in update. Initial 100.0.

fields.name: ground_distance_scale
fields.evidence: Unexported setter vtable +0x88 (f_71004c2010). When scale_by_ground_distance (+0x3B) is set, update multiplies a GroundModule distance (vtable +0x5A8) by this and limits it with size_min/size_max times the joint scale. Initial 1.5.

fields.name: offset_y
fields.evidence: set_offset_y export -> vtable +0x78 (f_71004c1ff0) stores the float here. No reader among the class's methods (probably read by the shadow renderer). Initial 0.

fields.name: draw_size
fields.how: computed: joint scale * clamp(size, size_min, size_max), or the ground-distance variant
fields.evidence: Unexported getter vtable +0xA8 (f_71004c2050). Written by update each frame (types 1/2) and by setup (= size). on_ground is forced 0 when it is <= 0. Initial 10.0. Bytes 0x2C..0x2F padding.

fields.name: joint
fields.evidence: Constructor stores Hash40 0x031ed91fca ('top', ParamLabels); setup stores its hash argument; unexported setter vtable +0x68 (f_71004c1fd0). update passes it to ModelModule vtable +0x140 and derives the joint scale from the returned matrix columns (half the sum of two column lengths).

fields.name: draw_flag[ShadowDrawFlag]
fields.evidence: set_draw(ShadowDrawFlag, bool) export -> vtable +0x48 (f_71004c1c70) stores bool at this+0x38+flag. update draws only when both +0x38 and +0x39 are set. reset (vtable +0x38) sets both to 1. Initial 1, 1.

fields.name: draw_status
fields.evidence: set_draw_status export -> vtable +0x50 (f_71004c1c80) stores arg&1. Required for drawing in update; reset sets it to 1. Initial 0.

fields.name: scale_by_ground_distance
fields.evidence: Unexported setter vtable +0x80 (f_71004c2000). Selects the GroundModule-distance size formula in update. Initial 0.

fields.name: visible
fields.evidence: update computes the draw decision (draw_flag[0] && draw_flag[1] && draw_status && !+0x3F && VisibilityModule is_visible (vtable +0xD0) && type rules && draw_size > 0) and, when it differs from this byte, calls ModelModule vtable +0x310(bool) if ModelModule vtable +0xA0 is true, then stores it. reset sets 1; slot +0x40 (f_71004c1c10) re-sends 1 to ModelModule. Initial 0.

fields.name: on_ground
fields.evidence: Unexported getter vtable +0xA0 (f_71004c2040). update (type 1 only): set when !+0x3F, +0x3E and VisibilityModule is_visible; then cleared if draw_size <= 0 or StatusModule situation_kind (vtable +0x168) is not 0 (ground). reset sets it to (type == 1). Initial 1.

fields.name: ground_shadow_enable
fields.evidence: Unexported setter vtable +0x98 (f_71004c2030); gates on_ground in update; reset sets it to (type == 1). Initial 1.

fields.name: force_hide
fields.evidence: Read by update: when set the shadow is hidden and on_ground is 0. No writer found among the class's methods (written elsewhere). Initial 0.

notes: One class, vtable 23 entries. Slots: +0x28 setup(type, size, joint) also registers a 0x28-byte listener; +0x30 unregister; +0x38 reset; +0x40 resend visibility to ModelModule; +0x48 set_draw; +0x50 set_draw_status; +0x58 per-frame update; +0x60 set_size; +0x68 set joint; +0x70 set size_min/max; +0x78 set_offset_y; +0x80 set scale_by_ground_distance; +0x88 set ground_distance_scale; +0x90 shadow_type; +0x98 set ground_shadow_enable; +0xA0 on_ground; +0xA8 draw_size; +0xB0 (f_71004c2060) returns false when not on ground, else writes a GroundModule point (vtable +0x408 with 8) to its output vector and returns true. Constructor stores the 8 bytes at +0x38 as 01 01 00 00 00 01 01 00.
